goal: P2: native-fidelity console on real backends — fidelity >= 90%, raise real coverage, no statics
must_build: Every page in ui-spec/azure/vms.json (48 pages; nav: Overview, Activity log, Access control (IAM), Tags, Diagnose and solve problems, Resource visualizer, Connect, Networking, Settings, Availability + scale, Security, Backup + disaster recovery, Operations, Monitoring)
Backend: ARM Microsoft.Compute virtualMachines over Vyomi's compute backend (grep providers/ core/ for azure vm): list/create/start/stop/delete, disks, NICs
List / create / detail / edit / delete round-trips through the native API the SDK and CLI use
always: Every page wired to the native API on /_wire (no static data); liveness fixtures for every list/detail page
core/capabilities/azure/vms.json: one entry per console section with an honest level + tests; tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py must pass
Capability feature ids MUST start with 'azure.' (e.g. 'azure.vms.<section>') — ids share one namespace with the AWS registry
Read the 'Cloud lenses' section of consoles/AGENT-UI.md first — use this cloud's kit, not Cloudscape
